=INSERT INTO prospects (
  first_name, last_name, company, title,
  linkedin_url, instagram_username, platform,
  industry, location, public_fact, best_angle,
  likely_pain_points, profile_score, icp_match,
  decision_maker, status, source, tags
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.first_name.replace("'", "''") }}',
  {{ $json.last_name ? `'${$json.last_name.replace("'", "''")}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.company ? `'${$json.company.replace("'", "''")}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.title ? `'${$json.title.replace("'", "''")}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.linkedin_url ? `'${$json.linkedin_url}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.instagram_username ? `'${$json.instagram_username}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.platform }}',
  {{ $json.industry ? `'${$json.industry.replace("'", "''")}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.location ? `'${$json.location.replace("'", "''")}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.public_fact ? `'${$json.public_fact.replace("'", "''")}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.best_angle ? `'${$json.best_angle.replace("'", "''")}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  ARRAY[{{ ($json.likely_pain_points ?? []).map(p => `'${p.replace("'", "''")}'`).join(',') || 'NULL::text' }}]::text[],
  {{ $json.profile_score ?? 0 }},
  {{ $json.icp_match ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }},
  {{ $json.decision_maker ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }},
  '{{ $json.status ?? 'new' }}',
  '{{ $json.source ?? 'import' }}',
  ARRAY[{{ ($json.tags ?? []).map(t => `'${t}'`).join(',') || 'NULL::text' }}]::text[]
)
ON CONFLICT (linkedin_url) DO UPDATE SET
  company = EXCLUDED.company,
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  profile_score = GREATEST(prospects.profile_score, EXCLUDED.profile_score),
  icp_match = EXCLUDED.icp_match,
  public_fact = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.public_fact, prospects.public_fact),
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, first_name, last_name, profile_score, status;

=INSERT INTO prospects (first_name, last_name, company, title, linkedin_url, instagram_username, platform, status, source, do_not_contact)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.first_name.replace("'", "''") }}',
  {{ $json.last_name ? `'${$json.last_name.replace("'", "''")}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.company ? `'${$json.company.replace("'", "''")}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.title ? `'${$json.title.replace("'", "''")}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.linkedin_url ? `'${$json.linkedin_url}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.instagram_username ? `'${$json.instagram_username}'\` : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.platform }}',
  'do_not_contact',
  '{{ $json.source ?? 'import' }}',
  TRUE
)
ON CONFLICT (linkedin_url) DO UPDATE SET
  status = 'do_not_contact',
  updated_at = NOW();

parameters.content:
## Workflow 0 – Import & Qualification

**Entrée** : POST /webhook/prospects/import
```json
{
  "prospects": [
    { "first_name": "Marie", "company": "TechCorp",
      "title": "CTO", "linkedin_url": "..." }
  ]
}
```

**Claude Haiku** utilisé pour la qualification (rapide + économique)
**Prompt caching** activé sur le system prompt (réduction ~80% coûts)

**Output DB** :
- Prospects qualifiés → `status = 'new'`
- Prospects DNC → `status = 'do_not_contact'`
